description.en: Matrix homeserver (Synapse) with Element Web, Cinny, the Ketesa admin UI, Element Call with LiveKit, coturn and the Draupnir moderation bot. Bridges (WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram, Discord, Steam, IRC) are separate modules.
description.de: Matrix-Homeserver (Synapse) mit Element Web, Cinny, der Ketesa-Verwaltung, Element Call mit LiveKit, coturn und dem Moderationsbot Draupnir. Bridges (WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram, Discord, Steam, IRC) sind eigene Module.
